Znlite 0.1.0 is an experimental, text-only live and installable image for 64-bit x86 laptops. It is based on Debian 13 Trixie and includes APT so the system can be expanded manually after installation.

This preview contains a custom Debian kernel package built from the pinned upstream Linux 6.12.111 source. The source archive, kernel package, live ISO, and SHA-256 checksums are attached to this release.

The image includes no graphical desktop. To add one after installing Znlite, connect to the network and install the desktop packages you want with APT. Changes made to the temporary live session do not persist after reboot.

This is a hardware-testing preview. Acer TravelMate B is a family with multiple model variants; exact CPU, Wi-Fi, storage, firmware, and BIOS/UEFI behavior have not been verified on the user's machine. Suspend, battery reporting, audio, Wi-Fi, and graphics may vary by model. Do not install over a drive containing data you need to keep.

The image is x86-64 only. Verify the SHA-256 checksum before writing the ISO to USB.
